t_advice_summary_textbox.text: keep picking the colours that score higher until they start scoring lower, then pick a different option because that one should then score higher

vb_textbox.text: You'll see the colours in pairs, e.g. red and yellow. If yellow scores lower, pick red until the score for red starts going down. i found it helped to recite the colours that were going well for me so I remembered which to pick, e.g. 'pink, purple, brown, red' and then when one switched just change the one you're saying. Say it out loud so you're not having to think, the choice is just obvious as they come up because you don't have long to decide.
